name: Weather forecast
description: A weather card with the next hours and days, for any place on Home.
about: A card for Home that shows the weather at a city you choose on the TV (Customise > Weather) or on the phone page (Cards > Set up from your phone): now, with the temperature, feels like, humidity, wind, rain chance, UV, air pressure, air quality and sunrise and sunset; the next hours; and the next days. The card is one button for the remote: OK opens a drawer with Now, Hours and Days. The weather comes from Open-Meteo (free, no key, no account): only the coordinates of the city you chose leave the TV, at most every 30 minutes. The idea and the first version are from @Edenik (pull request 129).
